texto:
Could you tell me about any unusual foods from your country? 
In mine, we have Karashi Renkon, which is lotus root stuffed with a mix of mustard and miso paste.
frase_cierre: Write without a name. Someone, far away, will read it.

respuesta.texto: In India we fry bitter gourd until it is crispy, and I still can't decide if I love it or not.
